simple_meaning: The permanent reference number for this person in our system.
why_we_collect_it: So the same person can be followed across the CRM, WhatsApp, the LMS and payments without confusion.
if_missing: Cannot be missing. The record cannot exist without it.

simple_meaning: What they are called.
why_we_collect_it: To address them properly and to check we are talking to the right person.
source: Lead form, counsellor or WhatsApp profile
if_missing: Messages use a neutral greeting with no name.
can_it_change: Yes, a counsellor can correct it.

simple_meaning: Their phone number in full international format.
why_we_collect_it: It is how we reach them and how we recognise them.
used_by: Whether we can contact them at all
if_missing: The lead cannot be worked. It goes to the data quality queue.
can_it_change: Yes, if they give a new number.

simple_meaning: The last ten digits of the phone number, used to spot the same person twice.
why_we_collect_it: It is how we check whether they are already a student or already in the system.
if_missing: Duplicate checking cannot run.

simple_meaning: Their email address.
why_we_collect_it: A backup channel, and a second way to spot duplicates.
if_missing: Email is simply not used.

simple_meaning: Whether they agreed to receive promotional messages from us.
why_we_collect_it: It is the legal gate on every promotional send.
source: The consent checkbox on the form
used_by: Whether any marketing message may be sent
can_affect: Whether any marketing message may be sent
if_missing: No marketing message may go out. Only a single opt in request.
can_it_change: Yes, they can withdraw it at any time.

simple_meaning: The exact moment consent was captured.
why_we_collect_it: It is the evidence if consent is ever questioned.
if_missing: Consent is treated as not captured.

simple_meaning: Whether WhatsApp will let us message them.
why_we_collect_it: WhatsApp is our main channel, so this decides whether the plan can run at all.
if_missing: Treated as never asked. Only a utility opt in request may be sent.

display_name: Why we are not contacting them
simple_meaning: The single switch that stops all outbound messaging, and the reason.
why_we_collect_it: One place to check before any send, so nobody is contacted who should not be.
allowed_values: none, opted_out, dnd, invalid, converted, duplicate, legal_hold
source: Calculated from opt outs, delivery failures, payments and merges
depends_on: Opt out events, delivery failures, payment success
if_missing: Treated as none, meaning contact is allowed.

simple_meaning: Where they are in education or work right now.
why_we_collect_it: It is the single biggest driver of what we say and what we send.
allowed_values: 24 values from school class 9 to working 5 years plus, plus Unknown
source: Declared, or inferred from the source
used_by: Cohort, playbook, fit score, resource choice, wording
can_affect: Cohort, playbook, fit score, resource choice, wording
conflicts_with: Course interest when the course does not suit the stage
if_missing: Set to Unknown. The message asks one question instead of assuming.
can_it_change: Yes. A declared answer always overwrites a guess.

display_name: How sure we are about their life stage
simple_meaning: Whether they told us, or we worked it out.
why_we_collect_it: It stops the system stating something as fact when it was only a guess.
allowed_values: Declared, Inferred high, Inferred low, Unknown
source: Calculated from where the value came from
used_by: Whether copy may name the life stage
if_missing: Treated as Unknown, which blocks life stage wording.
can_it_change: Yes, rises to Declared the moment they answer.

simple_meaning: What they are studying or have finished.
why_we_collect_it: It decides eligibility and which batch variant suits them.
allowed_values: School, B.Com, BBA, B.Tech, BA Economics, B.Sc Statistics, M.Com, MBA, CA qualified, CFA charterholder, Other, Unknown
if_missing: Eligibility stays Unknown, which blocks payment links.

simple_meaning: The year they finish or finished their degree.
why_we_collect_it: CFA registration depends on it, and so does placement timing.
if_missing: We ask for it before any CFA commercial step.

simple_meaning: How long they have been working.
why_we_collect_it: It separates a fresher from a professional, which changes everything we send.
if_missing: Life stage is inferred from other signals or left Unknown.

simple_meaning: What they do at work.
why_we_collect_it: A risk analyst asking about FRM gets a very different message from a general enquiry.
if_missing: Generic professional wording is used.

simple_meaning: Whether a parent is asking on behalf of a student.
why_we_collect_it: Parents need cost, outcomes and reassurance. Students need something else entirely.
source: Declared or detected from the language used
used_by: Playbook, tone, which assets are sent, call timing
if_missing: Treated as a student enquiry.

simple_meaning: The person who actually approves the spend.
why_we_collect_it: A sale cannot close through someone who is not the decision maker.
allowed_values: Self, Parent, Employer, Self with parent input, Unknown
source: Declared or established on a call
used_by: Fit score, which assets are sent, who gets called
if_missing: Assumed to be self, and flagged as unverified.

simple_meaning: The specific course, if they named one.
why_we_collect_it: It decides which content, price and batch are relevant.
allowed_values: 22 course codes plus General finance career and Unknown
source: Declared, or inferred from the page they came from
used_by: Cohort, resource choice, fit and intent, wording
can_affect: Cohort, resource choice, fit and intent
conflicts_with: Life stage when the course does not suit the stage
if_missing: The discovery playbook runs. No brochure is ever sent.

simple_meaning: Whether they named an exact product, a course, a category or just a direction.
why_we_collect_it: How specific someone is predicts buying better than which course they named.
allowed_values: Exact ask, Named course, Category only, Direction only, Unknown
used_by: Playbook, intent score, cadence, whether a counsellor is triggered
if_missing: Treated as Unknown, which starts discovery.
can_it_change: Yes, rises as they say more.

simple_meaning: The specific batch or package inside a course family.
why_we_collect_it: Price and hours differ by variant, so a fee answer is meaningless without it.
if_missing: No payment link may be issued.

simple_meaning: Whether the awarding body will let them sit this exam.
why_we_collect_it: Selling a course someone cannot register for creates a refund and a bad outcome.
allowed_values: Eligible, Eligible with condition, Not yet eligible, Ineligible, Unknown
source: Checked against the awarding body rules
used_by: Playbook, priority, whether a payment link may be issued
if_missing: Treated as Unknown, which blocks payment links until checked.
can_it_change: Yes, when the rules or their status change.

simple_meaning: Whether the course they want is the right one for where they are now.
why_we_collect_it: Someone can be eligible and still be making a mistake.
allowed_values: Suitable, Too early, Overqualified, Needs checking
used_by: Playbook, fit score, what we recommend instead
if_missing: Treated as Needs checking.

simple_meaning: How much time they can realistically give.
why_we_collect_it: It decides which variant is honest to recommend.
if_missing: Scored neutral. Asked with tappable ranges, never as an open question.

simple_meaning: What they can spend.
why_we_collect_it: It decides whether to lead with the variant, the instalment plan, or neither.
allowed_values: Under 10k, 10k to 25k, 25k to 40k, 40k plus, Price sensitive, Not disclosed
source: Declared or established on a call
used_by: Fit score, which variant is offered
if_missing: Scored neutral. Never guessed from city or college.

simple_meaning: Whether they need to pay in parts.
why_we_collect_it: Asking about instalments is a strong buying signal, not a weak one.
used_by: Intent score, which assets are sent, counsellor trigger
if_missing: Treated as false.

simple_meaning: Their own statement about timing.
why_we_collect_it: It sets how often we contact them and whether a counsellor is worth it now.
allowed_values: Immediate, Within 7 days, Within 30 days, 1 to 3 months, 3 months plus, Undecided
conflicts_with: Engagement when they say soon and then go quiet
if_missing: Scored as Undecided.
can_it_change: Yes. It is re checked after 14 days because it goes stale.

simple_meaning: The exam sitting they are aiming at.
why_we_collect_it: It decides which batch, how urgent it is, and whether the timeline is honest.
allowed_values: Month and year, or a window label
used_by: Intent score, batch matching, urgency wording
if_missing: The attempt planner is offered.

simple_meaning: How long until the sitting they are aiming at.
why_we_collect_it: Under 30 days with nothing studied means we should say no.
used_by: Intent score, urgency wording, cadence caps
if_missing: Attempt proximity scores zero.

simple_meaning: Whether they have started studying and how.
why_we_collect_it: It decides whether we diagnose first or sell first.
allowed_values: Not started, Self study, Studying elsewhere, Revision stage, Failed last attempt, Deferred
if_missing: Assumed not started for the purpose of honesty checks.

simple_meaning: Whether they have sat this exam before.
why_we_collect_it: Retakers need diagnosis, not a sales pitch, and a completely different tone.
allowed_values: None, One fail, Two or more fails, Deferred, Passed the previous level
source: Declared or from the student master
if_missing: Treated as none.

simple_meaning: Whether this person has ever paid us.
why_we_collect_it: It is the difference between selling and looking foolish.
allowed_values: Never purchased, Active student, Past student, Lapsed access
source: Matched against the student master on the phone number
used_by: Playbook, owner, whether acquisition messaging is allowed at all
if_missing: Treated as never purchased. A wrong answer here is expensive, so the match runs on every lead.

simple_meaning: What they have already bought.
why_we_collect_it: It is what makes a cross sell relevant instead of random.
if_missing: Cross sell cannot run.

simple_meaning: Any earlier contact with us that did not end in a purchase.
why_we_collect_it: Opening as a stranger to someone we already spoke to loses the only advantage we have.
allowed_values: None, Prior lead lost, Prior lead dormant, Webinar only, Scholarship exam only
if_missing: Treated as none.

simple_meaning: The exact entry point.
why_we_collect_it: It decides how the first message opens, what was promised, and how fast we must reply.
source: The form, the CRM or the entry integration
used_by: Message opening, response time target, intent score, resource choice
can_affect: Message opening, response time, intent score
conflicts_with: first_source and last_source, which are attribution only
if_missing: Treated as Unknown, which uses a neutral opening and a 4 hour target.
can_it_change: No. It is fixed at entry.

simple_meaning: The commercial grouping of the source.
why_we_collect_it: It sets how fast we must respond and how cost is reported.
allowed_values: Organic, Paid, Referral, Campus, Direct inbound, Existing database, Cross sell, Reactivation
used_by: Response time target, cost reporting, retargeting eligibility
if_missing: Defaults to the slowest response target.

simple_meaning: The specific thing the ad, form or event said they would get.
why_we_collect_it: Asking a question before delivering a promise is the fastest way to lose trust.
used_by: Blocks the first message until it is delivered
if_missing: Nothing is blocked. Assumed no promise was made.

simple_meaning: The title of the webinar or seminar they came from.
why_we_collect_it: Continuing from what they heard beats restarting the conversation.
conflicts_with: Location when the event city is not their city
if_missing: The opening does not reference an event.

simple_meaning: Where they live.
why_we_collect_it: It decides whether an in person option is real and when we can call.
source: The form, the counsellor or the phone code
used_by: Wording, in person options, call timing, which testimonial is used
conflicts_with: event_topic when the event was elsewhere
if_missing: No location is mentioned in any message.

simple_meaning: A size classification of the city.
why_we_collect_it: It changes what is logistically practical, and nothing else.
used_by: Which proof is used, whether an in person option is offered
if_missing: Treated as Unknown.

simple_meaning: The Indian state or union territory.
why_we_collect_it: Regional reporting and the default language.
if_missing: Reporting only.

simple_meaning: How far they are from a classroom.
why_we_collect_it: It decides whether an in person option is honest to offer.
used_by: Whether an in person option is offered
if_missing: In person options are not offered.

simple_meaning: The language they want to be contacted in.
why_we_collect_it: A reply in Hindi answered in English reads as a machine.
allowed_values: English, Hindi, Bengali, Hinglish, Other, Unknown
source: Declared or detected from their reply
used_by: Which template version is used, which counsellor is assigned
if_missing: English is used.

simple_meaning: How many of our messages they opened.
why_we_collect_it: Read and ignored means something different from never delivered.
used_by: Intent score, which silence branch runs
if_missing: Treated as zero, which is different from unknown and is flagged.

simple_meaning: How many links they opened.
why_we_collect_it: Clicking is a weak but real signal of interest.
if_missing: Treated as zero.

simple_meaning: The list of things they actually looked at.
why_we_collect_it: It stops us re sending the same thing and tells us what interests them.
if_missing: We may accidentally re send something. Tracking is a priority for this reason.

simple_meaning: How far through the last thing they got.
why_we_collect_it: Finishing something is worth far more than opening it.
if_missing: Only the open is counted.

simple_meaning: Whether they watched a sample class or attended a live one.
why_we_collect_it: Attendance is scarce and expensive to earn, so it is the strongest engagement signal we have.
source: The LMS or the webinar platform
used_by: Intent score, journey stage, counsellor trigger
if_missing: Treated as false.

simple_meaning: Whether the counselling call actually happened.
why_we_collect_it: Show rate is one of the few honest measures of interest.
if_missing: Treated as not attended.

display_name: Days since they last did anything
simple_meaning: How long they have been quiet.
why_we_collect_it: Intent decays with silence. This is what drives it.
conflicts_with: purchase_timeline when they claimed to be in a hurry
if_missing: Cannot be missing. Calculated from the record creation date if nothing else exists.

simple_meaning: When the link went out.
why_we_collect_it: It starts the recovery clock and defines the paying stage.
if_missing: No link has been sent.

simple_meaning: When the money landed.
why_we_collect_it: It is the conversion event, and it stops all marketing immediately.
if_missing: They have not paid.

simple_meaning: How many times a payment failed.
why_we_collect_it: Two failures is a payment problem, not a reminder problem.
if_missing: Treated as zero.

simple_meaning: What they paid, in rupees.
why_we_collect_it: Revenue reporting and cost per acquisition by cohort.
if_missing: Revenue cannot be attributed.

simple_meaning: How well this course suits this person, out of 100.
why_we_collect_it: It separates people we should sell to from people we should redirect.
used_by: Priority, whether a sales queue entry is allowed
depends_on: Life stage, Eligibility, Capacity, Relationship dimensions
if_missing: Cannot be missing. Unknown inputs score neutral, not zero.
can_it_change: Yes, whenever profile data changes. It never decays with time.

display_name: How sure we are about Fit
simple_meaning: Whether the fit score rests on declared facts or guesses.
why_we_collect_it: A score of 66 from two known fields is not the same as 66 from ten.
source: Calculated from how many inputs are declared
used_by: How the score is presented, briefing card warnings
if_missing: Shown as Low.

simple_meaning: How close this person is to acting, out of 100.
why_we_collect_it: It decides who gets a counsellor and how fast.
if_missing: Cannot be missing. Starts at the source baseline.
can_it_change: Yes, on every event, and it decays after 7 days of silence.

display_name: How sure we are about Intent
simple_meaning: Whether the intent score rests on real behaviour or on one declared line.
why_we_collect_it: Someone can say they are ready and do nothing.
source: Calculated from how much behavioural evidence exists
used_by: How the score is presented, briefing card warnings
if_missing: Shown as Low.

display_name: What to do about them now
simple_meaning: The action priority, in plain words.
why_we_collect_it: It is the counsellor queue order and the first thing a counsellor needs to read.
allowed_values: Call now, Call today, Call this week, Automated only, Redirect, Do not contact
source: Calculated from fit and intent together
if_missing: Cannot be missing.

simple_meaning: The group this person belongs to.
why_we_collect_it: It is what selects the playbook, and therefore everything we do next.
if_missing: The discovery cohort is used and the miss is logged.
confidence: Shown with the rule that assigned it

simple_meaning: Cohorts this person also qualifies for.
why_we_collect_it: If the first cohort is wrong, this is where the counsellor looks next.
if_missing: Only one cohort fitted.

simple_meaning: The plan we are running for this person.
why_we_collect_it: It is the sequence of messages, resources and calls the team will actually execute.
used_by: Which messages and resources are sent, cadence, owner
conflicts_with: journey_stage, which is where they are, not what we do
if_missing: The discovery playbook runs.

simple_meaning: Where this person currently is, from New to Enrolled.
why_we_collect_it: It is the one word answer to where are they, and it controls what automation is allowed to run.
allowed_values: New, Contacted, Engaged, Interested, In conversation, Ready to buy, Paying, Enrolled, Parked
used_by: Which automation may run, reporting, stuck detection
conflicts_with: assigned_playbook, which is our plan, not their position
if_missing: Cannot be missing. Everyone starts at New.

simple_meaning: When they entered the current stage.
why_we_collect_it: It is how we spot leads that are stuck.
if_missing: Cannot be missing.

simple_meaning: If they are not active, the stated reason.
why_we_collect_it: Parked is not one thing. Too early and not interested need completely different handling.
allowed_values: Free text or a standard reason
if_missing: They should not be parked without one.

simple_meaning: The single next thing to do.
why_we_collect_it: So nobody has to interpret the scores to work out what to do.
example: Send the skills check, then call once it is completed
source: Calculated from the cohort, stage and priority
if_missing: Cannot be missing.

simple_meaning: The date the next action is due.
why_we_collect_it: It turns a soft maybe later into a firm appointment.
source: Calculated or agreed with the lead
if_missing: The action runs at the next permitted window.

simple_meaning: Who owns this lead.
why_we_collect_it: Accountability, and so the lead does not get two people calling.
if_missing: The lead sits unassigned, which is flagged if the priority is high.

simple_meaning: The share of decision critical fields we have.
why_we_collect_it: A confident sounding score built on three fields deserves a warning.
used_by: Confidence levels, whether to ask another question
if_missing: Cannot be missing.

simple_meaning: The specific fields still blank that matter for this cohort.
why_we_collect_it: It tells the counsellor exactly what to ask on the call.
used_by: Which question is asked next, briefing card
if_missing: Cannot be missing.

simple_meaning: Fields where two sources disagree.
why_we_collect_it: The system says less rather than guessing, and a person resolves it.
used_by: Which message blocks are suppressed, verification tasks
if_missing: No conflicts detected.

simple_meaning: Which validation rules fired on the last evaluation.
why_we_collect_it: It is the honest answer to why did it do that.
used_by: Explanation shown to the user, blocked actions
if_missing: Nothing fired.

simple_meaning: The plain English reason for the cohort, the scores and the next action.
why_we_collect_it: So anyone can see why the system decided what it decided without asking a developer.
example: Assigned to college employability because life stage is final year and no course was named.
source: Built during evaluation from the rules that fired
if_missing: Cannot be missing. An evaluation without an explanation is a bug.

simple_meaning: How many things we have asked them that went unanswered.
why_we_collect_it: Three unanswered questions means stop asking.
used_by: Whether another question may be asked
if_missing: Treated as zero.

simple_meaning: How many messages we have sent in total.
why_we_collect_it: It is the cap that protects the list from fatigue.
if_missing: Treated as zero.

simple_meaning: The first campaign or channel that ever brought them to the site.
why_we_collect_it: Marketing attribution. It never drives a message.
conflicts_with: source_detail, which is the business answer
if_missing: Attribution is incomplete.

simple_meaning: The most recent campaign or channel before they converted.
why_we_collect_it: Marketing attribution. It never drives a message.
conflicts_with: source_detail, which is the business answer
if_missing: Attribution is incomplete.
